acceptanceCriteria.text: Expo SDK 52 app created at apps/mobile/
Expo Router v4 with 5 tab shells: Dashboard, Sessions, Scores, Arcade Mode, Settings
expo-sqlite + Drizzle ORM configured with same schema as web (packages/db-schema)
Sync engine: POST /api/sync → delta → merge into SQLite
Settings screen: SEGA ID + password input, POST /api/settings
App builds and runs on Android emulator or device

checkpointPayload.description: Bootstrap the Expo app, set up SQLite with Drizzle, implement sync engine, and stub all 5 tab screens.
checkpointPayload.title: Phase 1 — Expo Scaffold and Sync Engine
